q1.explanationZh: assess 及物动词“评估；评价”，名词是 assessment。

q2.explanationZh: assign“分配；布置（作业）”，注意不发音的 g，名词 assignment“作业；任务”。

q3.explanationZh: assist“协助，帮助”，名词 assistance“帮助”，assistant“助手”。

q4.explanationZh: assist 加 -ant 表示人，assistant“助手，助理”，shop assistant“售货员”。

q5.explanationZh: associate 及物动词“使有联系”，常用 associate A with B。

q6.explanationZh: associate 的名词形式 association“协会；联合”。

q8.explanationZh: assume 去 e 加 -ption 构成名词 assumption“假定；承担”。

q9.explanationZh: assure“使确信；向……保证”，常用 assure sb. of sth.。

q10.explanationZh: astonish 及物动词“使惊讶”，语气比 surprise 强，名词 astonishment。

q11.explanationZh: astro-“星，天体”+ naut“航行者”，astronaut“宇航员”。

q12.explanationZh: astronomy“天文学”加 -er 表示人，astronomer“天文学家”。

q13.explanationZh: at 是介词，表示在某一点（地点、时刻）上，如 at that time。

q14.explanationZh: athlete 名词“运动员”，形容词是 athletic。

q15.explanationZh: athlete 的形容词形式 athletic“运动员的；运动的”。

q16.explanationZh: Atlantic“大西洋的”，专有名词首字母大写，the Atlantic (Ocean)“大西洋”。

q17.explanationZh: atmosphere“大气；气氛”，cultural atmosphere“文化氛围”。

q18.explanationZh: atom 名词“原子”，形容词 atomic“原子（能）的”。

q19.explanationZh: attach“连接；使依附”，常用 attach A to B，名词 attachment“附件”。

q20.explanationZh: attack 动词、名词同形，“攻击；侵害”，注意词尾 -ck。

q21.explanationZh: attain 及物动词“达到；获得”，名词 attainment。

q22.explanationZh: attempt 动词、名词同形，“试图；尝试”，attempt to do“试图做”。

q23.explanationZh: attend“出席，参加（会议、课程等）”，名词 attendance。

q24.explanationZh: attention 名词“注意”，pay attention to“注意”。

q25.explanationZh: attitude 名词“态度”，常用 attitude to/towards。

q26.explanationZh: attract 及物动词“吸引”，名词 attraction，形容词 attractive。

q27.explanationZh: audience 指一群“听众；观众”，是集合名词。

q28.explanationZh: audio“声音的”+ visual“视觉的”，audio-visual“视听的”，中间有连字符。

q29.explanationZh: aunt 指父母的姐妹或叔伯舅的妻子。

q30.explanationZh: author 名词“作者”，注意拼写 -or。

q31.explanationZh: authority“权力，权威”，复数 authorities 表示“当局”。

q32.explanationZh: auto 是 automobile 的缩略，意思是“汽车”，复数 autos。

q33.explanationZh: automatic 形容词“自动的”，副词 automatically。

accept: assign sb. sth./assign sth. to sb.

q34.explanationZh: assign sb. sth. = assign sth. to sb.“把某物分配给某人”。

q35.explanationZh: attempt to do“试图做”，attempt 后接不定式。

q36.explanationZh: attach A to B“把 A 系在 / 附在 B 上”，to 是介词。

accept: at the risk of one’s life

q38.explanationZh: at the risk of“冒着……的危险”，“冒着生命危险”= at the risk of one’s life。

q39.explanationZh: at the moment“此刻，目前”，常与现在进行时连用。

q40.explanationZh: at the mercy of“任由……摆布”，mercy 意为“仁慈”。

q41.explanationZh: at the cost of“以……为代价”，of 后接名词。

q42.explanationZh: at present“现在，目前”，present 前不加冠词。

q44.explanationZh: at first sight“乍一看；一见（就）”，如 love at first sight“一见钟情”。

q45.explanationZh: at all costs = at any cost“不惜一切代价”，注意 all 后用复数 costs。

q46.explanationZh: at a loss“茫然不知所措”。

q47.explanationZh: assure sb. of sth.“向某人保证某事”，介词用 of。

q48.explanationZh: associate A with B“把 A 和 B 联系起来”，介词用 with。

q49.explanationZh: “你会把这么大的雪和什么联系起来？”associate ... with ...，助动词 do 后用原形。

q50.explanationZh: assure sb. of sth.“向某人保证某事”，叙述过去的事用过去式 assured。

q51.explanationZh: consider doing sth.“考虑做某事”，attend 用动名词 attending。

q52.explanationZh: 物主代词 his 后用名词，attempt at doing sth.“做某事的尝试”。

q53.explanationZh: be attached to“附属于”，被动结构用过去分词 attached。

q54.explanationZh: attach A to B“把 A 贴到 B 上”，句子缺谓语，用过去式 attached。

q55.explanationZh: shop assistant“售货员”，作句子主语，用名词单数。

q56.explanationZh: the more 后接可数名词复数，“参赛的运动员越多”用 athletes。

q57.explanationZh: has + 过去分词构成现在完成时，attract“吸引”用 attracted。

q58.explanationZh: “是观众养活了明星”，audience 作集合名词指观众们，谓语用复数 provide。

q59.sampleAnswer: It suddenly occurred to me why this store with a long history has been operating and enduring for centuries when I saw the serious and responsible attitude and unique techniques of its staff.
references: It suddenly occurred to me why this store with a long history has been operating and enduring for centuries when I saw the serious and responsible attitude and unique techniques of its staff.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “我突然明白……”可用 It suddenly occurred to me...；“认真负责的态度”= serious and responsible attitude；“经营几个世纪”用现在完成进行时。

q60.sampleAnswer: One of the educational objectives of school is to attain a balanced development of students.
references: One of the educational objectives of school is to attain a balanced development of students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “……之一”= one of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is；“得到均衡发展”= attain a balanced development。

q61.sampleAnswer: They have been given college scholarships purely on athletic ability.
references: They have been given college scholarships purely on athletic ability.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “获得奖学金”可用被动 have been given scholarships；“凭体育特长”= on athletic ability，athletic 是形容词。

q62.sampleAnswer: This female scholar, originally deeply engaged in the field of scientific research, has eventually become an astronaut through her persistent efforts and extremely strict training.
references: This female scholar, originally deeply engaged in the field of scientific research, has eventually become an astronaut through her persistent efforts and extremely strict training.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “深耕于”= be deeply engaged in，用过去分词短语作插入语；“成为一名宇航员”= become an astronaut，astronaut 以元音开头用 an。

q63.sampleAnswer: Many artists went out onto the streets to spread various art forms and convey positive energy, enriching the city’s cultural atmosphere.
references: Many artists went out onto the streets to spread various art forms and convey positive energy, enriching the city’s cultural atmosphere.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “为城市增添了文化氛围”用现在分词短语 enriching the city’s cultural atmosphere 表结果。

q64.sampleAnswer: The stage design of the concert is known for its innovation and high-tech elements, bringing the audience a unique audio-visual experience.
references: The stage design of the concert is known for its innovation and high-tech elements, bringing the audience a unique audio-visual experience.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “以……而闻名”= be known for；“给观众带来……”用现在分词 bringing sb. sth.；audio-visual“视听的”。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: 主语 Her dedication 是第三人称单数，一般现在时用 astonishes。

q66.sampleAnswer: Whatever I do, I always attach importance to efficiency.
references: Whatever I do, I always attach importance to efficiency.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “注重……”= attach importance to...；“无论我做什么”= Whatever I do。

q67.sampleAnswer: People who are aware of the importance of health are paying more and more attention to their diets.
references: People who are aware of the importance of health are paying more and more attention to their diets.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “意识到”= be aware of，用定语从句修饰 People；“越来越关注”= pay more and more attention to，“正在”用现在进行时。

q68.sampleAnswer: Audience who attended the industrial exhibition all sang the praises of the family automatic alarm system promoted by this exhibitor.
references: Audience who attended the industrial exhibition all sang the praises of the family automatic alarm system promoted by this exhibitor.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “赞不绝口”= sing the praises of；“自动报警系统”= automatic alarm system；“所推广的”用过去分词 promoted by 作后置定语。
